REFLECTION.decision: The acceptor payload encodes LOCAL (4-token acceptor-window) SPLICE-SITE STRENGTH (held-out, calibrated). The frozen model-INDEPENDENT local-MaxEnt contribution (V2b) and the model own acceptor confidence (V3) each name it; the full-23nt MaxEnt (V2a) does NOT -> the payload is the local window, not the whole site (cross-validates A7 PPT-null). Not exact identity (V1). Composition (V4) NON-IDENTIFIABLE -> a composition confound is not fully excluded.
REFLECTION.calibration: BOTH controls pass after 4 iterations (the gate caught 3 decision-layer bugs: categorical-test-for-ordinal, loose bootstrap-CI significance FPR=0.18, weak planted direction NaN-equivalence). planted-positive corr_r=0.9998 monotonic (sensitivity); permuted-label FPR=0.047<=0.05 out-of-sample (specificity); value_linearity=exact; self/empty positive control OK.
REFLECTION.V2b_local_maxent: NAMES it: held-out r=-0.512, monotonic, |r|>r_thresh=0.302, equivalence eq=0.986 in [0.80,1.20]. Model-INDEPENDENT, frozen MaxEnt (maxentpy 0.0.4). The sign is set by the V2b definition (local-window contribution over a CAGG reference); what matters is significant+monotonic transfer.
REFLECTION.V3_model_logit: NAMES it: held-out r=+0.62, monotonic. The model own acceptor confidence tracks the coupling. Circular (model-internal) -> supports, cannot alone establish biological meaning; V2b (external) carries that.
REFLECTION.V2a_full_window_null: Full 23nt MaxEnt does NOT name it (r=-0.035, non-monotonic). The full window includes the 20nt intronic flank / PPT-adjacent positions, which the payload IGNORES -> CROSS-VALIDATES A7 (dPPT~0): the payload is the LOCAL acceptor window, not the whole 3-prime splice site.
REFLECTION.V1_V4: V1 (exact identity) does not name it (energy-stratified drop strat=-0.049) -> not sequence memorization. V4 (composition) NON-IDENTIFIABLE (0 matched pairs; L1-distance calipers formed none) -> composition confound OPEN (follow-up: re-run V4 with looser calipers).
REFLECTION.dissociation: V2b and V3 each name it with the OTHER competitor-matched in their contrastive pairs -> separately identified, not merely a composite; but they are biologically correlated (local splice strength ~ model acceptor confidence).
REFLECTION.scope: Value-path (L3H1 address held clean), held-out genes, permutation-calibrated. Names the WHAT of the payload the L0->L1->MLP2 generator (A8) builds = LOCAL acceptor-window splice-site strength. Composition confound not excluded. U_info projected-onto, not refit.
REFLECTION.completes_arc: A6 (not a sparse circuit) -> A7 (acceptor-local serial generation) -> A8 (serial L0->L1->MLP2 MLP-backbone generator) -> A9 (that generator computes LOCAL splice-site strength). The mechanism now-named end to end.

verdict_label_note: Corrected from the script v1 coarse logic (which only checked V2a): the LOCAL 4-tok MaxEnt (V2b) is the payload-extent-matched external scorer and it names the payload; V2a (full 23nt) does not -> local-window localization.
